core_philosophy: A cinematic, high-end party aesthetic. Ground the neon chaos with deep void black layers. Use light (cyan/pink/lime) as an architectural element to guide the eye, not as a blanket background. Emphasize motion, music, and energy through UI.

headings.usage_rules: Never center by default. Use fluid scaling up to text-6xl. Apply text-shadow or subtle glowing drop-shadows on hero text to make it pop against dark backgrounds.

body.usage_rules: Keep it highly legible, text-base to text-lg. Use text_secondary (#94A3B8) for long paragraphs.

labels.usage_rules: Use for overlines, tags, and small metadata.

grid_modes.services: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris) - mix tall and wide cards, wide gaps (gap-8)
grid_modes.experience: Masonry or offset grid to feel dynamic and energetic

components.cards: Use 'Tracing Beam' or 'Grid Borders' micro-theme. Dark matte background (bg-[#0A0A0A]), 1px white/10 border. On hover, the border glows cyan or pink.
components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.
components.buttons: High contrast. Primary CTA uses cyan or pink background with black text. Hover state increases brightness.

motion_interactions.hero: Use TSParticles for floating neon dust/lasers, and React Three Fiber for a glowing, rotating disco ball in the background (if feasible), or high-end parallax images.
motion_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth scrolling. This provides the premium momentum.
motion_interactions.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a subtle colored drop-shadow (e.g., shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)]).
motion_interactions.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` for the client logos. Monochromatic/grayscale logos on a pure black background to contrast with the neon hero.

components_instructions.hero_section: Auto-slideshow of high-energy event images. Overlay must be gradient (black/80 to transparent) to ensure text readability while letting the image shine. Include a prominent 'Book via WhatsApp' CTA.
components_instructions.services_grid: Custom HTML/Tailwind bento grid. Clicking a service opens a Shadcn Sheet (side-panel) with a detailed photo/video gallery and a specific WhatsApp CTA.
components_instructions.marquee_logos: Slow, organic drift. If exact logos are missing, use stylized typography (Outfit font, uppercase, tracking-widest, text-white/40).
components_instructions.gallery_bento: Mixed photos and videos. Use framer-motion to stagger entrance on scroll.
components_instructions.whatsapp_integration: Floating WhatsApp button (bottom right, high z-index, glowing green pulse). Contact form submission should intercept and open a pre-filled WhatsApp link: `https://wa.me/60133446521?text=...`
components_instructions.admin_panel: Simple, dense, functional. Use Shadcn components. No glassmorphism here; use solid dark backgrounds with clear borders.

hero.description: DJ with neon lights - high energy hero

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text over neon backgrounds meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Use black text inside neon cyan/pink buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react react-fast-marquee @studio-freight/lenis tsparticles @tsparticles/react`
Set up the Unbounded and Outfit fonts in the global CSS or Tailwind config.
Build the UI prioritizing a cinematic dark mode. Use deep blacks (#050505), not generic grays.
Use Shadcn Sheet component for the Service details side-panel.
Implement the WhatsApp form logic to generate a wa.me URL and open it in a new tab.
For the admin panel, use a separate route (`/admin`) and apply the 'Control Room' grid (dense, tight gaps, flat surfaces).
